welcome_offer.description: Variable welcome offer: apply and find out your welcome offer, as high as 85,000 Bonus Miles after you spend $6,000 in purchases on your new Card within the first 6 months of Card Membership. Welcome offers vary and you may not be eligible for an offer; American Express shows the exact amount after you apply. No fixed public offer amount is published.
notes: Delta's official business-card page shows 90,000 Bonus Miles after $6,000/6 months, ending November 4, 2026.
CNBC Select independently reports the same public limited-time offer and expiry.

2026-11-13 weekly-audit fix (PR #91 finding expired_offer_still_current): the 90,000-mile / $6,000 limited-time offer ending November 4, 2026 is no longer shown. Official Amex page (rendered GET 200, 2026-11-13 PT): "Apply and find out your welcome offer AS HIGH AS 85,000 Bonus Miles after you spend $6,000 in purchases on your new Card within the first 6 months of Card Membership. Welcome offers vary and you may not be eligible for an offer." delta.com business-cards page (rendered GET 200) hero: "Delta SkyMiles® Gold Business Amex Card APPLY AND FIND OUT YOUR WELCOME OFFER AS HIGH AS 85,000 BONUS MILES After you make $6,000 in eligible purchases on your new Card within the first 6 months of Card Membership. Welcome offers may vary and you may not be eligible for an offer." Neither page shows an 'Offer ends' date or limited-time/increased-offer language. The 'as high as' amount is targeted/variable, so it is not published as a fixed bonus: bonus_points set to 0 with bonus_value 'Varies', estimated_value removed, expires_at removed, offer_status -> as_high_as_ymmv, is_elevated -> false (decided from current page copy, not from the expiry date). Spend/months are the fixed terms stated on both official pages.

2026-11-13 bonus_points_max 85,000 added (lead decision; display shows 'up to X / varies'). Re-confirmed on the official Amex page (rendered GET 200, 9:37:21 PM PST): "AS HIGH AS 85,000 Bonus Miles after you spend $6,000 in purchases on your new Card within the first 6 months of Card Membership". bonus_points stays 0 / Varies; sorting unaffected.
source_conflicts: delta.com business-cards page 'Quick Business Card Comparison' table still says 'Earn 90,000 Bonus Miles' (no spend/date), conflicting with the same page's hero and the Amex page ('as high as 85,000'); treated as a stale leftover of the expired 11/4/2026 offer and not applied.

recurring_credits.name: Delta Stays Credit
recurring_credits.description: Up to $150 annual statement credit on prepaid hotels or vacation rentals booked through Delta Stays on delta.com. No spending requirement.

recurring_credits.description: Up to $10/month statement credit on eligible U.S. rideshare purchases with select providers after Card renewal. Enrollment required.
